decisions.reason: Reducing the corrective submission to one reference-matching clip does not cancel or alter the requirement that each selected moment form a complete standalone lesson or story.
The source changes the corrective clip count and reference constraint but does not alter the established clean and simple editing rules.
Requesting one clip modeled on the supplied reference does not necessarily remove or modify the standard for selecting strong and impactful moments.
The source does not change the existing caption color, font, or effects requirements.
Changing the corrective submission to one clip does not alter the required 30-to-90-second duration range.

The necessary qualification impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, which changes the method and required count to one reference-matching corrective clip and removes the obsolete deadline.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY updating the advancement pathway from a three-clip gate to a single reference-matching corrective clip; no additional change is required.
The source does not change the established project-chat submission channel or the submission content used for guideline review.
The one-clip corrective qualification request does not change the subsequent quota of 125 approved clips per month.
